services.name: Sunset Social
services.desc: Are you ready to take your next event up a notch? Our custom cruises are the ultimate way to kick back, have fun, and soak in the vibes of the Charleston Harbor. With spacious boats, top-of-the-line sound systems, and plenty of space to dance, chill, and take in the views of the Holy City, our boat charters have everything you need for an epic celebration on the water. Get ready to celebrate like never before! Hop aboard for a birthday bash filled with music, dancing, and endless good vibes. Gather your crew, and let's make it a day to remember. Round up your squad for the ultimate hangout on the water. Whether you're cruising, partying, or just kicking back with a drink, this is one day
